Claims (2)

1. A tyre valve comprising a body, a poppet, and a seat formed by an elastomeric ring retained in the body, the ring being deflectable outward by inflation pressure to enlarge the flow passage.
2. The tyre valve of claim 1, wherein the ring is a lip seal of nitrile rubber of hardness 60 to 80 Shore A.

Description

[0008] The stated problem is sealing against dust and sealant particles; the reference does not describe removing deposits.
